rules.data_missing: No stable device id is stored (the push token stands in). Rider payment instruments are not stored, so a shared card or UPI cannot be matched.
rules.data_used: Referral rows; push token (as the device), phone numbers incl. emergency contact, driver payout UPI / bank account (salted hashes).
rules.summary: A referral reward was blocked because the two accounts share a device, a phone number or a payout instrument.
rules.title: Referral abuse

rules.data_missing: No stable device id, advertising id or install id is stored; the push token changes on reinstall, so a determined user can slip past it. No payment instrument is stored for riders.
rules.data_used: Rider accounts created in the window; push token (the device); phone numbers by their last ten digits; emergency contacts; first-ride promo redemptions.
rules.summary: Several rider accounts share a push token, a phone number or an emergency contact.

thresholds.hint: Smallest group of linked accounts that raises a flag.
thresholds.label: Accounts in a group
Look at accounts created in the last

rules.title: Multiple accounts

rules.data_missing: No rider-driver relationship (family, employer) is stored, so a legitimate daily commute looks the same as trading trips. Pickup and drop proximity between pair trips is not compared yet.
rules.data_used: Completed trips (rider, driver, zone country); driver incentive progress.
rules.summary: The same rider and driver complete many trips together, or a driver's trips are mostly with a few riders, especially while an incentive is in progress.

thresholds.label: Driver trips before concentration is judged
Share of trips with that set

rules.title: Rider-driver collusion

rules.data_missing: Recorded distance and duration come from the trip, not from an independent source; a trip with neither is not judged. Pickup and drop being the same place is not compared.
rules.data_used: Trips that counted toward a driver incentive; their recorded distance and duration.
rules.summary: A driver's incentive progress is mostly very short trips.

thresholds.label: A trip under this distance is short
Short counted trips before a flag

rules.title: Incentive farming

rules.data_missing: The app does not send a mock-location or developer-options flag, the strongest spoofing signal, nor the device's own sensor speed. A dead zone also leaves a short trail, so a single trip is never enough.
rules.data_used: Completed trips in the last day; their sampled location trail and billed distance.
rules.summary: Completed trips whose location trail has impossible jumps, or is far shorter than the distance billed.

thresholds.label: Impossible jumps for a trip to count
Judge trail length only for trips billed at least
and with at least this many trail points
Trail shorter than this share of billed is short

rules.title: GPS anomaly

rules.data_missing: There is no explicit "fee waived" marker; a refund recorded on a rider-cancelled trip stands in for it. The cancellation reason is free text, so a driver cancelling because the rider asked them to is not separated out.
rules.data_used: Trips with an accepted time, who cancelled; refunds recorded on trips.
rules.summary: A driver accepts and then cancels too often, or a rider cancels after a driver accepted and keeps getting the money back.

thresholds.label: Driver: share cancelled by the driver
Rider: cancels after a driver accepted

rules.title: Cancellation abuse

rules.data_missing: No card or UPI fingerprint is stored (the gateway response carries none), so several accounts failing on one instrument cannot be tied together. A failed payment is not separated from a rider's bank declining it.
rules.data_used: Payment rows (status, method) and completed trips with a cash payment that never completed, in the window.
rules.summary: A rider has repeated failed online payments, refunds or unpaid cash trips.
rules.title: Payment abuse

rules.data_missing: No card fingerprint is stored, so the same card on two rider accounts is not tied together. A bank decline is not told apart from a deliberate one.
rules.data_used: Failed online payment rows (not a switch of method) on trips between the rider and the driver, in the last 90 days.
rules.summary: A rider's payments failed on two or more trips with the same driver in 90 days; the driver was paid each time.
rules.title: Failed payments with one driver
